warnings: /dev/shm is 11.7 GiB against 11.9 GiB usable RAM. It is a RAM-backed tmpfs, so that ceiling competes with training. Size it near 2 GiB.
notes: batch scaled 8 -> 3 for imgsz 640 -> 960 (activation memory goes as pixel count).
Ultralytics accumulates gradients to nbs=64, so a smaller batch does not change the effective batch size or the learning-rate schedule - only wall-clock per epoch.
